description: Net worth split by how quickly it could actually be reached: accessible cash, invested money (reachable but only by selling), property equity, and pensions (reached at a birthday) - plus how many months of bills and debt payments the accessible cash alone would cover. The same figures as the 'What you could reach' card on the Money MOT page (Tools > Money MOT). Use for 'how much can I actually get to', 'what's my emergency fund', 'how much of my money is locked away', 'what's my runway'.
name: get_wealth_shape
title: What you could reach
